definitions.ask: Should authored [[links]] take the first SEE ALSO chips, ahead of phrase mentions?
definitions.why: Deliberate links should not be crowded out of the 1-9 keys by incidental phrase matches

choices.label: Link targets fill chips first and never fall past the 9-chip cap; mentions follow
One first-occurrence order across links and mentions, like the Memory panel strand card

definitions.ask: Should the card also list links that leave the glossary (e.g. [[decisions/x]]) or do not resolve?
definitions.why: SEE ALSO numbers are follow keys, and the card can only follow glossary terms

choices.label: The card lists glossary terms only; those links stay as authored text in the definition
Adds an unnumbered display-only LINKS row naming each non-glossary or unresolved target
